# #2382: Patch: a player watching the finished match's replay is still taken to the rematch both sides agreed to
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

After an online game, you can press Rematch and open the replay while you wait. If your opponent accepts, the new game starts with its clocks running, but you stay in the replay and nothing tells you, until you press Back. Once this is built, you're taken to the new game, as you already are when you only looked at the board.

## Why

- `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx:389` returns the replay (`OpenedReplay`) before the board's side rail is built.
- The only rematch watcher that outlives the result panel lives in that rail (`match.tsx:523`). Its comment (`match.tsx:517-522`) says it exists so a seat that folded the panel "would never" miss "the game the offers created". The replay path drops it.
- `RematchWatcher` (`apps/web/src/routes/Rematch.tsx:83-88`) navigates as soon as the rematch answer carries a match id. Nothing polls for that answer while the replay is open.

## Proposal

Render `RematchWatcher` in the replay branch too, behind the same `series === null` gate.

## Where it lands

`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx` and `apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx`. SPEC §9.5 (rematch).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A test modelled on `match.test.tsx:1076` ("takes the seat to the rematch even after View the board folded the panel"): a finished match, a rematch offered, the replay opened, and the rematch poll answering `match-2`. The page navigates to `/match/match-2`.
- [ ] A series game mounts no watcher in either branch.
- [ ] Leaving the replay shows the result panel as it does today.

## Size and risks

Easy: about 10 lines and a test, in one app. The seat only leaves the replay for a rematch it offered itself, which is what the existing watcher already does from the board.
